story: Meet the African Crowned Eagle (Stephanoaetus coronatus), a distinctive bird from the Accipitridae family. Preferring habitats such as Forests; woodlands; savanna; shrubland; plantations; and urban greenspaces, this species has adapted to thrive under specific environmental conditions. With an IUCN status of Near Threatened (NT), its population trends are closely watched by scientists and enthusiasts. The African Crowned Eagle serves as an indicator species for the health of its environment. Whether you are a seasoned ornithologist or a curious nature lover, learning about the African Crowned Eagle enriches our understanding of nature.
